subject: Renewal kickoff: Nimbus Health — capacity uplift, term options & QBR scheduling
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Thompson <claire@nimbushealth.com>, Amir Chaudhry <amir.chaudhry@nimbushealth.com>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Jul 2026 09:13:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal kickoff: Nimbus Health — capacity uplift, term options & QBR scheduling

Hi Claire / Amir —

Thanks for the continued partnership. With your contract up for renewal in mid-August, I wanted to start the renewal kickoff so we can align on capacity needs, term options, and schedule a QBR to go over usage, performance, and the proposed commercial changes.

High-level proposal / asks:
- Capacity: you flagged spikes last quarter that breached the Dedicated pool; recommendation is a 20% reserved uplift (additional 4 x A100 slots) with burst policy to absorb monthly peaks.
- Term: offer options for 12/24-month commitments; 24-month gives a deeper price break and predictable throughput guarantees.
- QBR: propose week of Aug 10 — 30–45 minute session focused on usage trends, performance optimizations, and rollout plan for the uplift.

Attachments: Nimbus_renewal_roadmap_v1.pdf (initial timeline + milestones).

Can you confirm: (1) who on your side owns procurement / legal for this renewal, (2) who should attend the QBR (technical + exec/stakeholder list), and (3) whether the Aug 10 week works for a meeting? Once I have that I’ll book the invite and loop in Laura for pricing and Rachel for onboarding/CS prep.

Next steps from our side:
- I’ll circulate a draft mutual-action plan and two pricing options (12/24 mo) for review.
- Laura will prepare a redline-friendly MSA and scope-of-work for the uplift.
- Rachel will run the pre-QBR usage baseline and ops checklist.

Thanks — looking forward to lining this up.

Best,
Vivek Kulkarni
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0137

[Attachment: Nimbus_renewal_roadmap_v1.pdf (PDF, 1.2MB)]

From: Claire Thompson <claire@nimbushealth.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Amir Chaudhry <amir.chaudhry@nimbushealth.com>, procurement@nimbushealth.com
Date: Tue, 14 Jul 2026 11:02:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Renewal kickoff: Nimbus Health — capacity uplift, term options & QBR scheduling

Thanks Vivek — appreciate the early start.

Quick answers:
- Procurement / Legal: procurement@nimbushealth.com (copied) will own contracts; Amir is the engineering lead and should be on the technical portion.
- Stakeholders for QBR: Myself (Head of Data Product), Amir (Eng Lead), + one of our Platform SREs (I’ll nominate Sarah once I confirm availability).
- Aug 10 week: the 11th/12th looks best for us; prefer late-morning (EST).

A couple of asks before the QBR so we can prepare:
1) Can you include expected latency SLOs after the proposed uplift and any cost delta estimates?
2) Please flag any security or compliance changes tied to the Dedicated capacity increase — we’ll likely need a short SOC2 evidence call with our security team.

I’ll loop procurement in on any contract docs and we’ll aim to get an initial read by the 20th.

Onward —
Claire
Claire Thompson
Head of Data Product | Nimbus Health
claire@nimbushealth.com

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Claire Thompson <claire@nimbushealth.com>, procurement@nimbushealth.com
Date: Fri, 16 Jul 2026 10:27:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal kickoff: Nimbus Health — capacity uplift, term options & QBR scheduling

Fwd-ing pricing + MSA notes —

Hi all — I pulled together two commercial options and a redline draft of the MSA for early feedback.

Summary (see renewal_pricing_options.xlsx attached):
- Option A (12 mo): +20% reserved capacity; 12-month term; price increase ~12% vs current AR; no change to SLOs; included 10% burst allowance.
- Option B (24 mo): +20% reserved capacity; 24-month term; price increase ~5% vs current AR; includes SLA credit language and prioritized capacity ramp dates.

Legal / procurement notes:
- MSA_redlines_2026-07-16.docx highlights the new throughput SLA, a tiered credit schedule, and data residency clarity for your regions.
- If procurement wants to accelerate approval, we can provide a redline comparison doc and a short 30-min legal triage call.

Operational notes for the QBR:
- Rachel: can you confirm the usage baseline in the last 90 days? I highlighted a few burst windows in the spreadsheet but want the exact figures to call out in the QBR.
- Vivek: propose we offer a 30-day trial of the uplifted pool after signature to validate performance before the first billing cycle.

I’ll wait for procurement feedback on the MSA. If Claire / Amir agree to the 11th or 12th for the QBR, I can join and walk through the pricing redlines.

Thanks — Laura
Laura Bennett
Manager, Renewals & Commercial Operations | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.ai

[Attachment: renewal_pricing_options.xlsx (XLSX, 85KB)]
[Attachment: MSA_redlines_2026-07-16.docx (DOCX, 45KB)]

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Thompson <claire@nimbushealth.com>, Amir Chaudhry <amir.chaudhry@nimbushealth.com>, procurement@nimbushealth.com
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 21 Jul 2026 15:43:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal kickoff: Nimbus Health — capacity uplift, term options & QBR scheduling

Thanks everyone — quick confirmation and next steps.

1) QBR scheduled: Aug 11, 2026 at 11:00 AM EST — calendar invite sent here: https://calendar.redwood.ai/event/0a1b2c3d-nimbus-qbr-20260811
2) Pre-QBR deliverables (from Redwood):
   - Finalized pricing sheet (Laura) — will send an update by Jul 23.
   - Usage baseline + ops checklist (Rachel) — will send by Jul 27.
   - SOC2 evidence pack & short compliance summary (Monica) — will be ready by Jul 28; we’ll coordinate the security triage call once Nimbus confirms participants.
3) Contract progression: Laura has shared MSA redlines; procurement/nimbus, please confirm if you want a legal triage call the week of Jul 20.
4) Trial: per Laura, we’ll provide a 30-day uplift trial window to validate performance immediately after signature — no billing until the start of the next cycle.

Claire / Amir: if the above looks good I’ll lock the invite and set up the legal triage call. Appreciate the quick turnaround — goal is to have sign-off by Aug 5 to ensure a smooth cutover mid-August.

Best,
Vivek
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai

[Attachment: Nimbus_renewal_roadmap_v1_updated.pdf (PDF, 1.3MB)]
